validationNotes: Official Voice v8, opcode/close-code, DAVE and change-log bytes were verified on 2026-10-18 without authenticated Discord calls; exact hashes are in voice-sessions-current-sources.json. Grouped upstream introduction dates remain unknown.

No production dependency, root resolved pin or product was added. DAVE imports Voice; Voice imports neither DAVE/MLS nor HTTP/Gateway/Client/Cache/OAuth/Kit. Shared main-Gateway control is injected. The separate measurement tool selects the existing NIO transport; VoiceBot remains adapter-free.

The first ten-minute release measurement ran concurrently with builds/tests and is retained verbatim as voice-sessions-local-duplex-contended.json with its environment. All 60,000 packets and 57,600,000 decoded sample frames passed integrity/cleanup, but p99 28.404ms exceeded the 20ms period, with 481 processing overruns, 738 late schedule slots and resident memory growth. This is a failed timing/resource qualification result, not a pass. Attribution to host contention is unproven.

Final review corrected close/admission and late source/control-retention races, preserved live heartbeat debt during asynchronous E2EE authorization, retained UDP receive ownership across WebSocket resume, bounded and joined replacement cleanup, and canceled/joined owned playback sources. Idle/late pacing reanchors instead of accumulating arbitrary catch-up debt. Deterministic held-operation regressions exercise these boundaries; simulated control/readiness remains distinct from real MLS/DAVE media authentication.

Final release source/configuration and executable fingerprints remained unchanged throughout build and measurement. Complete two-direction tick wall time includes pipeline-internal pacing suspension, asynchronous UDP latency, authentication and decoding; only the explicit main-loop clock wait is excluded. It is not pure CPU cost and cannot establish a computational regression relative to earlier revisions.

Final measured integrity/cleanup passed, but RSS rose 4702208 bytes after warmup. First/last-minute median RSS was 18595840/19988480 bytes; actual last-minute RSS still increased 32768 bytes. The cause is unassigned. Bounded media/socket/timing accounting and empty final queues do not establish zero resident growth or independent absence of leaks. The full qualification requirements gate is not met.
qualificationLimits: Authorized Discord smoke was not run: no application-owned credentials, permitted guild/channel, consenting peer, trusted external sender and participant keys were available. Standalone local peers do not establish main-Gateway/SFU interoperability.

No independent cryptographic review or complete independent-client handshake was performed. Published primitives, existing MLS vectors, same-code peers and a local encrypted exchange do not provide those qualifications.

Synthetic PCM and injected source failure do not exercise audio permission/routing, device hot-unplug, acoustic quality or hardware underrun telemetry. Actual Apple and other-platform/minimum-OS/device qualification remain separate gates.

Local processing percentiles, schedule misses, actual RSS and accounted queue bytes are reported separately. A successful integrity exit does not certify the qualification requirements's p99, zero-underrun or zero-resource-growth gates. No production, fleet, video or full voice media claim follows.

The final local p99 criterion passed, while three ticks exceeded the period and measured RSS increased. Retained raw software timing/RSS evidence is a qualification limit; no runtime, allocator, instrumentation or scheduler cause was isolated.
